headline: Uganda State Oil Firm Says EACOP Pipeline is 92% Complete
summary: Uganda's state oil company stated that the EACOP pipeline to Tanzania is 92% complete, with first oil shipments slipped to before the end of June 2027.
why: Major energy infrastructure projects dictate regional crude export capacities, capital expenditures, and future supply timelines for international oil markets.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Progress on major pipeline infrastructure impacts long-term regional oil export capacity.
